baseline.equivalence_test: raw connected-XX readout exactly matches QCCW for identical local parameters and inputs

core_invariants: enumerate all fifteen unordered key pairs; labels and evidence slots are not plugin inputs
do not construct or apply an attention action in this diagnostic
keep four trainable parameters for quantum and sine/cosine controls
do not modify, rerun, or tune the failed QCCW Stage-0

invariants: all fifteen pairs are enumerated once
no label, evidence-slot, attention-score, or gold-candidate argument

plugins.insertion_point: QCCW joint state after CZ and before pair aggregation
plugins.hypothesis: coherent-minus-dephased four-body YYYY phase parity retains cross-feature pair information not captured by a four-parameter rank-two classical trigonometric interaction
plugins.output_schema: connected_YYYY_coherent_minus_dephased pair score plus secondary connected_YY diagnostic
plugins.resource_estimate: 4 qubits, 4 trainable parameters, 2 CZ gates, exact statevector

plugins.insertion_point: computational-basis dephasing on key-b register before YY readout
plugins.hypothesis: complete dephasing of key-b removes every cross-register YYYY expectation
plugins.resource_estimate: same state preparation; analytic density-matrix-equivalent dephasing null

plugins.insertion_point: QCDD state with both CZ gates removed
plugins.hypothesis: connected YYYY is zero for the matched pure product state
plugins.resource_estimate: 4 qubits, shared 4 local parameters, 0 two-qubit gates

plugins.insertion_point: candidate-pair readout on the same two local features
plugins.hypothesis: a tied four-parameter sine/cosine embedding may reproduce the phase-sensitive pair ranking classically
failure_signatures: comes within 0.02 AUC of QCDD on either held-out split

plugins.insertion_point: second key view before QCDD encoding
plugins.hypothesis: a fixed within-query roll of key-b destroys evidence-pair dependence while preserving one-key marginals
plugins.resource_estimate: same QCDD circuit and parameter budget

plugins.insertion_point: same QCDD state with connected XX instead of differential YY
plugins.hypothesis: raw connected XX records whether QCDD adds information beyond the failed QCCW readout
plugins.resource_estimate: same state and parameters; readout-only control
failure_signatures: raw XX and differential YY are numerically identical

composition.merge_rule: evaluate one readout at a time; no attention residual or selector composition

validation.baseline_equivalence: raw connected XX equals QCCW for identical states and parameters
tests: analytic dephased YYYY null equals explicit density-matrix dephasing
quantum and sine/cosine parameter counts both equal four
finite nonzero QCDD and control gradients
smoke run writes the frozen readout manifest

reproducibility.environment: Python >=3.10, torch >=2.0, ideal exact statevector, CPU or one CUDA device

limitations: This is a seed-7 readout diagnostic and cannot authorize multi-seed, attention-action, or task-utility claims.
Training targets may use labels and evidence pairs, but plugin inference receives neither.
Exact statevectors and analytic dephasing remain classically simulable.
The shot calculation is an estimate, not a finite-shot execution or hardware benchmark.
